mapper.sql: id , stat_date, product_key, channel, metric_type, metric_value, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_dashboard_statistics (stat_date, product_key, channel, metric_type, metric_value, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{productKey}, #{channel}, #{metricType}, #{metricValue}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'message_total' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as totalMessages, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'message_success' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as successMessages, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'message_failed' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as failedMessages, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'message_push' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as pushMessages, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'message_retry' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as retryMessages FROM iot_dashboard_statistics WHERE stat_date = #{statDate} AND product_key IS NULL AND channel IS NULL

SELECT stat_date as statDate, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'message_total' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as totalMessages, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'message_success' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as successMessages FROM iot_dashboard_statistics WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND product_key IS NULL GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT channel, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'message_total' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as messageCount FROM iot_dashboard_statistics WHERE stat_date = #{statDate} AND product_key IS NULL AND channel IS NOT NULL GROUP BY channel ORDER BY messageCount DESC

SELECT stat_date as statDate, channel as channel, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'message_total' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as totalMessages, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'message_success' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as successMessages FROM iot_dashboard_statistics WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND product_key IS NULL AND channel IS NOT NULL GROUP BY stat_date, channel ORDER BY stat_date, channel

SELECT stat_date as statDate, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'device_total' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as totalDevices, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'device_online' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) as onlineDevices FROM iot_dashboard_statistics WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND product_key IS NULL AND channel IS NULL AND metric_type IN ('device_total', 'device_online') GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date
